notes: Representative prompts for the Prompt Intelligence Engine. must_preserve lists substrings (case-insensitive) every revision has to keep; expected_missing lists missing-information keys the analysis should raise; output_checks are applied to model answers when the harness runs tasks against a live model.

cases.prompt: Build an ecommerce website
Build an ecommerce website for my bakery. It must support online orders and pickup scheduling. Do not use WordPress.
Write a Python function that validates UK postcodes using a regex. Include unit tests with pytest and handle lowercase input.
My React component re-renders on every keystroke and the input loses focus. Explain the bug and fix it. Keep the answer under 200 words.
Write an email to my landlord asking to fix the broken heating by Friday. Use a polite but firm tone and keep it under 120 words.

Could you please write a blog post about remote work for HR managers. Please make sure to keep it under 500 words. Please make sure to keep it under 500 words. Don't mention COVID. Use a friendly tone.
Draft a LinkedIn post announcing that our team shipped version 2.0 of our invoicing app. Mention the 3 headline features and end with a question.
Research the evidence on whether blue light from screens affects sleep in teenagers. Use peer-reviewed studies from the last 10 years and cite every source.
Compare the evidence for intermittent fasting versus calorie restriction for weight loss. Summarise the findings in a table.
Create a go-to-market strategy for our B2B scheduling software entering the German market. We have a budget of $50,000 and a team of 3.
Suggest a pricing strategy for a premium coffee subscription. Compare three options and recommend one.
Write SEO meta descriptions for 5 product pages of a vegan skincare brand. Each must be under 155 characters and include the keyword 'cruelty-free'.
Plan an Instagram campaign to launch our new running shoes to women aged 25 to 40.
Analyse sales.csv and find the top 5 products by revenue in 2024. Output a markdown table with columns product, revenue, growth. Do not include returns.
Using the customer dataset, calculate monthly churn rate and visualise the trend. Flag any outliers.
Explain photosynthesis to a 12 year old student and give me a 5 question quiz at the end.
Create a lesson plan for teaching fractions to beginners, with learning objectives and a homework task.
Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle. Keep it whimsical and under 800 words.
Brainstorm 20 names for a cat cafe in Tokyo. Avoid puns about milk.
Create a project plan with milestones for migrating our CRM to a new vendor over 6 months. Include risks and dependencies.
Turn this backlog into a two-week sprint plan for a team of 4 developers: login page, password reset, audit log, rate limiting.
